Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in G.R. Case No.1251 of 2022 pending on the file of learned S.D.J.M.,
Dhenkanal, arising out of Dhenkanal Town P.S. Case No.526 of 2022 for commission of the offence under Sections 419/420/120-B/468/471/34 IPC.

3. Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s. 439 Cr.P.C by the learned Addl.
Sessions Judge, Dhenkanal, by order dated 22.10.2022 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.

4. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the allegation against the present Petitioner is that he is a neighbour of the Informant and taking advantage of his patta with him he along with Debasish Pattnaik showed him a piece of land allegedly belonging to one Susamarani Panda and later on it came to fore that another co-accused had impersonated the said Susamarani Panda and in the process the victim was stated to have been duped of Rs.8 lakhs.
5. Learned counsel for the State on the basis of the materials on record submits that all the co-accused persons stated to have taken Rs.4 lakhs from the victim.

sentences.text: 1 Petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned court in seisin subject to verification of the criminal antecedent of similar nature.
7. If the Petitioner has any such antecedent, this order shall stand recalled.

8. Additionally it is directed that taking into account the allegation that all the Petitioners in connivance with each other have taken Rs.4 lakhs which comes to the fore on the basis of the agreement, which is on record, this Court directs the Petitioner to furnish cash security of Rs.1,00,000/- (rupees one lakh) before the learned Court in seisin.
9. The same shall be kept in a short term interest bearing account to be pledged in the name of the court and subject to final outcome of the trial.
10. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
11. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rule.
